📢 PhD Student Position - AG Millanvois 🇩🇪
Freie Universität Berlin | Institute for Chemistry and Biochemistry

Topic: From Overlooked Inorganic Gases to Modern Organic Chemistry

Research:
Prepare inorganic gases and volatile fluorinated sulfur(VII) species like NSF3, X2N-SF5. Derive them for modern organic chemistry. Develop new methods and reagents as PFAS replacements for pharmaceutical and material applications.

Position & Training:
- Preparation of gaseous/volatile inorganic materials using Schlenk and gas-handling
- Use and derivatization of these reagents for organic synthesis
- Full characterization: NMR, IR, XRD, DSC, DFT calculations
- Supervision by Dr. Alexandre Millanvois

Requirements:
- MSc in Chemistry or close to completion
- Interest in organic/molecular chemistry expanding to inorganic/gas-phase
- Fluent English required. German/French a plus. Schlenk experience a plus

Funding:
- Monthly stipend: 1,850€ income-tax free, +100€/month per child
- Up to 1,000€/year for literature, equipment, conferences
- Duration: 3 years. FCI/Stiftung Stipendien-Fonds funding

Apply by: 1 October 2026 | Start: Q4 2026 to Q1 2027
Send CV + 1 page cover letter + 1-2 recommendation letters to: alexandre.millanvois@fu-berlin.de
Subject: PhD Position, AG Millanvois

#PhD #Chemistry #FluorineChemistry #OrganicChemistry #InorganicChemistry #FUberlin
